1. Introduction 
Ricoh eTerminal is a Gespage software module dedicated to Ricoh MFPs. This module uses the 
integrated touch screen of the MFP. 
 
This module enables an authentication at the MFP to provide the following functions: 
- 
Print2me secured print with user authentication (by login / password, PIN code, RFID card) 
and user-friendly selection of the documents to print. 
- 
Modification of the job properties (print in B&W, in 
duplex or change of the number of copies). 
- 
Scan to me by email or to a home directory. 
- 
Payment and accounting of pr

-

duplex or change of the number of copies). 
- 
Scan to me by email or to a home directory. 
- 
Payment and accounting of prints, copies and scans in 
Gespage. 
- 
Access rights to copy, print (B&W, color) and scan 
functions. 
- 
Management and configuration of the terminal from a user-friendly Web interface. 

Gespage eTerminal Ricoh Manual - 003

6
1.1 Compatibility 
Gespage eTerminal is compatible with all Ricoh MFPs with SDK/J version 10 and higher. The Ricoh 
MFP must have their Java platform enabled. 
 
The card readers that can be connected are Cartadis card readers such 
as TCM3. 
Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

7
2. Configuration 
2.1 Configuration on the MFP 
Before configuring the MFP, the printer queue for your MFP must first be set on your Gespage 
server. 
2.1.1 Initial configuration of the MFP 
To allow Gespage to control the MFP, the two following parameters have to be changed in the SP 
mode: 
 
Parameter SP-5-113-001: 
- Default Optional Counter Type -> 0: None. 
 
Parameter SP-5-113-002: 
- External Option Counter Type -> 1: Expansion Device 1. 
 
NOTE: These parameters can only be set by a Ricoh technician. 
Gespage eTerminal Ricoh Manual - 003

Gespage eTerminal Ricoh

2.1.2.1 
Automatic installation of Gespage application 
This is the recommended mode of installation of Gespage eTerminal (see §2.2.2.1). 
 
NOTE: If one supplied you with a specific version of the application, the files must be placed on 
Gespage server in the installation directory under GespageCore\server\resources\medias\ricoh. 
(Attention, the default files must be named Gespa

NOTE: If one supplied you with a specific version of the application, the files must be placed on 
Gespage server in the installation directory under GespageCore\server\resources\medias\ricoh. 
(Attention, the default files must be named GespageRicohServlet.zip and GespageRicoh.zip). 
2.1.2.2 
Manual installation of Gespage application 
This configuration is only necessary if the automatic installation of the application cannot be 
achieved automatically (see Annex § 4.1). 
2.1.3 MFP configuration 
After the installation of the application, to determine which MFP functions are controlled by 
Gespage, you need to configure them directly in the MFP Settings. 
 
According to the model of MFP, click the UT Mode button or move to the menu "User Tools / Device 
Functions" 

Select System Settings, Administrator Tools tab and Enhanced External Charge Unit Management. 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

2.1.4 Scan configuration 
Gespage configurations for scan to email or home directory can be stored in the MFP address book. 
 
Scanned files must be sent by FTP on Gespage server which forwards them to the user email or home 
directory. 
2.1.4.1 
Scan to home directory 
Prior to this configuration, the Gespage functionality of scan to FTP server must be activated (see 
Gespage manual). 
 
Record setting for sending a scan to home directory is: 
- 
FTP Server: Gespage server address 
- 
FTP Port: 7121 
- 
Path: scan_home_dir/Agent_Name/Printer_Name (respecting the character case, it is 
recommended to use a printer name without special characters) 
- 
Login: admin (customizable) 
- 
Password: 123456 (customizable). 
 
2.1.4.2 
Scan to me by mail 
Prior to this configuration, the Gespage functionality of scan to me by mail to FTP server must be 
activated (see Gespage manual). 
 
Record setting for sending a scan to home directory is: 
- 
FTP Server: Gespage server address 
- 
FTP Port: 7121 
- 
Path: scan /Agent_Name/Printer_Name (respecting the character case, it is recommended 
to use a printer name without special characters) 
- 
Login: admin (customizable) 
- 
Password: 123456 (customizable). 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

2.2 Gespage configuration 
2.2.1 General 
2.2.1.1 
Global parameters 
Gespage server address (IP or name) has to be checked in the global parameters of the server 
(Server/ Global Parameters) to make the dialogue possible between eTerminals and Gespage server. 
 
Make sure that the required licences are available. From Server / Support / Licence, information 
about your Gespage Server and the licenses bought are available. An e

arameters) to make the dialogue possible between eTerminals and Gespage server. 
 
Make sure that the required licences are available. From Server / Support / Licence, information 
about your Gespage Server and the licenses bought are available. An eTerminal can be installed only 
if you have a Ricoh eTerminal license available or if your server is in demo mode. 

2.2.1.2 
Network flows 
Ricoh eTerminal communicates with Gespage service on the TCP ports 7180/7181. 
 
In case of scan to me by mail or to a home directory, Ricoh eTerminal communicates to Gespage 
server on the port 7121 (default) for the command channel. The FTP data channel ports depend on 
the FTP server configuration (default in active mode). 
 
Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

2.2.2 eTerminal configuration 
2.2.2.1 
Installation of eTerminal application 
Before configuring Ricoh eTerminal, the printer matching your MFP must first be set up on your 
Gespage server. Ricoh eTerminal must then be created in Gespage. 
 
CAUTION! Make sure to have entered the correct serial number of the unit in eTerminal 
configuration. The MFP serial number is available on the web interface of the unit 
(Status/Information, Device information, Machine ID). 
 
When the configuration of your Ricoh eTerminal is validated, Gespage application is automatically 
registered on your MFP (your unit is rebooted by this setting). If the MFP is not connected to the 
network, its configuration must be validated again when it will be online to register Gespage 
application. 
 
During Ricoh eTerminal configuration under Gespage, it must be linked to the MFP print queue 
previously created. 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

2.2.2.2 
Update of eTerminal application 
In case the automatic update of the application is activated, it will be updated automatically on all 
eTerminals when the application files will be updated on Gespage server. 
 
These files are to be updated on Gespage server under GespageCore\server\resources\medias\ricoh. 
2.2.2.3 
eTerminal general parameters 
2.2.2.3.1 eTerminal identification 
Name 
The eTerminal name must be filled in. The name is free but 2 identical names cannot be entered. 
Serial number 
Serial number of the MFP. This parameter must be filled in. 
Ricoh eTerminal is only identified by its serial number. 
The MFP serial number is available on the web interface of the unit (Status/Information, Device 
information, Machine ID). 
MFP Address 
The address of the MFP is the IP address or the MFP network name on which the eTerminal is 
installed. 
Comments 
Comments are optional. 
2.2.2.3.2 Card reader 
Reader profile 
Name of a reader profile associated with the card reader. 
The reader profile is an advanced setting useful when non-standard card readers have to be 
connected or when the numbers of the cards stored on Gespage do not match the standard format. 
2.2.2.3.3 Public mode 
Public mode 
This parameter enables public access to the MFP for accessing certain MFP functionalities in free 
access. Accounting operations will be performed under a public user account to create in Gespage. 
This account will define the access rights to self-service functions in Gespage. 
2.2.2.3.4 Release of prints 
Print job release 
Release of prints may be automatic which allows a

s will be performed under a public user account to create in Gespage. 
This account will define the access rights to self-service functions in Gespage. 
2.2.2.3.4 Release of prints 
Print job release 
Release of prints may be automatic which allows a release of jobs on the MFP as soon as printing is 
sent from the user PC. In all other cases (release on a login or card swipe) “Manual“ should be 
chosen. 
 
Manual releasing condition 
If release is set to manual, an automatic release may be chosen as soon as the user login is entered 
(printing of documents directly after login), or release after selection of jobs on the MFP (user action 
to release the prints). 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

Configuration 
 
15
Activate configuration on printer 
The Activate configuration on printer function enables a menu in the job release screen to change 
print job properties. The user can change his prints directly from the screen of the MFP. According to 
the configuration selected, he can modify the number of copies of his print, force the duplex and 
force black and white. 
2.2.2.3.5 Activation of configuration 
Activate configuration on printer 
This parameter enables or disables the eTerminal deployment on the MFP (by installing or 
uninstalling Gespage applications automatically). 
2.2.2.4 
eTerminal advanced parameters 
Some advanced settings are configurable from the Advanced parameters tab of the eTerminal. 
 
• 
auto_logout=180 
This parameter defines the disconnection timeout of the eTerminal (in seconds). Note that 
this setting is only taken into account if it is less than the equivalent setting of the machine 
(menu Timer/Auto Logout Timer). 
• 
conf_public_username=public 
This parameter defines the user account name used for accounting and rights of the acc

this setting is only taken into account if it is less than the equivalent setting of the machine 
(menu Timer/Auto Logout Timer). 
• 
conf_public_username=public 
This parameter defines the user account name used for accounting and rights of the account 
of public access. 
• 
device_wim_username=admin 
Administrator login of the MFP. This parameter is required to enable the firmware automatic 
push. 
• 
device_wim_password=password 
Administrator login of the MFP. This parameter is required to enable the firmware automatic 
push. 
• 
firmware_autoupdate_enabled=true 
This parameter enables automatic updating of Gespage applications on the MFP. 
• 
firmware_autoupdate_filename=GespageRicoh 
Firmware name of the Xlet Gespage application (for automatic updating). 
• 
firmware_servlet_autoupdate_filename=GespageRicohServlet 
Firmware name of the Servlet Gespage application (for automatic updating). 
• 
polling-timeout=180 
This parameter defines the refresh period of the eTerminal (in seconds). 
• 
screen_timeout=30 
This parameter defines the timeout of popup information windows on the MFP (in seconds). 
2.2.3 eTerminal general configuration 
In the screen of Ricoh eTerminals general configuration, set up the parameters to be applied to all 
Ricoh eTerminals on the site.

The main parameters are described hereafter: 
 
Allow to self-register 
This parameter enables self-registration of the eTerminals by manual installation of the application. 
 
For a keyboard login 
This parameter is used to select the user login mode on the keyboard. 
Input of Gespage account only: 
The user will only enter his Gespage login. 
Input of account and password: 
The user will enter his Gespage login and his password. 
Input of the print code: 
 
The user will enter his print code. 
 
Allowed logins 
This parameter is used to select the peripheral for login. 
1. Card and keyboard 
The user login may be made by card or keyboard. If no card reader is connected, keyboard 
login will be the only option. 
2. Card only 
The keyboard is inactive. The MFP only takes the card reader peripheral to log the user. 
3. Keyboard only 
The card reader peripheral is inactive. Login will be made only by the keyboard. 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

Association card ID to user 
This parameter allows the user himself to associate his account with the card via the keyboard of the 
MFP. By checking Done by the administrator, the association of the card must be carried out by the 
administrator either directly in the user profiles of Gespage either by synchronization or import (see 
Gespage manual). 
 
NOTE: The interface language of the eTerminal will be the language set on the MFP.

4.1.1 Application customization 
Gespage Ricoh application is available on Gespage server in the installation directory under 
GespageCore\server\resources\medias\ricoh. 
 
The GespageRicoh.zip file must be customized by opening the zip file and changing the file named 
"GespageRicoh.dalp" with a text editor. The address of your Gespage server must be entered in the 
serverIP parameter of the "application-desc" tag. 

Gespage eTerminal Ricoh Manual - 003

4.1.2 Application registration 
When configuring your MFP via the web interface, it is recommended to check that the MFP is not 
turned off or on standby and that nobody is logged in on it. 
 
The web interface of your MFP is accessible by just entering its IP address in your browser, using the 
ID "admin" and the password to have access to all the configuration menus. 

Manuel Gespage eTerminal Ricoh - 003

and Install. 

Select the previously customized GespageRicoh.zip and click Display Extended Feature List to install 
the application. 

Select Gespage application, put Auto Start to On, choose the installation media of the application 
and click Install. It is recommended to install to the Flash memory if available, otherwise the SD Card 
if available, otherwise to the HDD.

Once Gespage application is installed, it is displayed in the list of applications in Startup Setting 
menu. 

Select Gespage application and click Start. 
 
For a proper operation of the application, increase the heap size allocated to it. For this, move to 
Device Management menu, then to Configuration, Administrator tools and enter the maximum value 
allowed of the Heap Size parameter (here 64MB). 

To start the application on your MFP, you can reboot your MFP or select the Home button and 
choose Gespage App. 
 
Again, start this procedure to install the servlet GespageServlet by following the same procedure 
(apart from zip file customization that is not required). 
 
Once the 2 applications installed, it is recommended to reboot the MFP. 
 
eTerminal Ricoh application is now installed on MFP.
